paper.title: Diagnosis of epilepsy based on EEG — A New Feature Expansion Technique Combined with Shunt Gated Recurrent Unit Neural Network for Epileptic Seizure Diagnosis (Code Ocean capsule 6746514; no manuscript supplied)
paper.source_note: Capsule README/metadata/stored outputs used as the study description

findings.evidence: Literal arrays (deep_checks.py): code/fig_6.py plots GRU scores[...][0] = 92.76 (Dataset 1); the per-fold values typed into code/fig_5.py (Acc4, labelled GRU) average 93.10 over 10 folds. The other GRU summary values match their arrays exactly, so this one does not come from the stored per-fold results.
findings.question_for_authors: Which run produced the plotted value, and why does it differ from the mean of the per-fold values?

findings.evidence: MinMaxScaler.fit_transform is called before the first split (line 87); if it sees test data, information leaks into training.
findings.question_for_authors: Were preprocessing steps fitted on the training data only?

findings.evidence: [G2] Are inclusion/exclusion rules stated, with counts removed at each step? -> not_reported. No inclusion/exclusion rules; all 11,500 rows used, no filtering step in code.
findings.question_for_authors: Are inclusion/exclusion rules stated, with counts removed at each step?

findings.evidence: [M1] Are random seeds stated, and are results reported over several seeds? -> not_reported. No random_state / seed anywhere; XGBoost, RF and the Keras models are stochastic. leakage_scan.py flags 10 seed_missing sites. Also at: code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:17; code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:29; code/RawData_ML_Kfold.py:17; code/RawData_ML_Kfold.py:29; code/pca_test.py:23; code/pca_test.py:35; code/wave_test.py:23; code/wave_test.py:35; repro_ml.py:20; repro_ml.py:23.
findings.question_for_authors: Are random seeds stated, and are results reported over several seeds?

findings.evidence: [M4] Were preprocessing steps (scaling, feature selection, imputation, PCA) fitted on training data only? -> not_reported. MinMaxScaler(feature_range=(-1,1)) is fitted on the full 11,500-row dataset before KFold; the PCC weights are also computed on all rows including the label. Transductive preprocessing; leakage_scan.py flags the same pattern in code/wave_test.py:84.
findings.question_for_authors: Were preprocessing steps (scaling, feature selection, imputation, PCA) fitted on training data only?

findings.evidence: [M5] Are hyperparameter search space, budget and selection criterion stated (selected on validation, not test)? -> not_reported. Hyper-parameters fixed by hand (max_depth=5, n_estimators=10, C=1.0); no search, no validation split.
findings.question_for_authors: Are hyperparameter search space, budget and selection criterion stated (selected on validation, not test)?

findings.evidence: [M10] If the paper credits specific features or descriptors for the performance, is there a negative control (random or shuffled features, one-hot identity encoding, y-randomisation)? -> not_reported. No negative control for the PCC-WFE feature (no y-randomisation, no shuffled-label feature).
findings.question_for_authors: If the paper credits specific features or descriptors for the performance, is there a negative control (random or shuffled features, one-hot identity encoding, y-randomisation)?

findings.evidence: Metric definitions (deep_checks.py): sensitivity/precision come from sklearn with recall_score average='macro' in one pipeline (code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:12 recall_score average='macro'; code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:13 precision_score average='macro'; code/RawData_ML_Kfold.py:12 recall_score average='macro') and from a binary TP/(TP+FN), TP/(TP+FP) count for one class in another (code/perform.py). Values with the same name are not the same quantity, so a table comparing them across methods is not like for like.
findings.question_for_authors: Were Se/PPV computed with the same definition for every method compared?

findings.evidence: Pipeline coverage (deep_checks.py): code/SGRU_GRU_Kfold.py trains GRU, SGRU, which no script of the entry point (code/run) trains; the entry point never runs it and the stored output has no lines from it. The figure scripts plot numbers for GRU, SGRU as typed-in literals, so those numbers cannot be traced to a stored run. Also never run: code/pca_test.py, code/wave_test.py.
findings.question_for_authors: Can the log or results of SGRU_GRU_Kfold.py be added to the capsule?
